summary: Arvinas, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on June 11, 2026, HSR clearance was granted for a License Agreement with Rigel Pharmaceuticals for global rights to VEPPANU (vepdegestrant). The upfront payment of $70M was distributed evenly between Arvinas and Pfizer, with an additional $15M upon completion of transition activities and up to $320M in contingent milestones plus tiered royalties. This replaces prior Pfizer milestone obligations. The filing updates on regulatory clearance and closing conditions. Watch for milestone achievement and transition completion to gauge cash flows and deal execution.
